Official Ceremony Schedule & Order of Rites

THE PROGRAM

Banquet Hall, 5th Deck, AIMS Tower • Friday, November 13, 2026

3:00 PM I. Registration
3:15 PM II. Opening Rites
3:35 PM III. Main Activity
5:30 PM IV. Fellowship
3:00 PM – 3:15 PM Arrival & Registration

Registration, Greetings and Seating

Welcome desk check-in at the 5th Deck Banquet Hall. Distribution of event programs, badge verification, and escort to reserved seating decks.

3:15 PM – 3:25 PM Opening Ceremonies

Invocation & Institutional Hymn

Solemn Invocation, singing of the Philippine National Anthem, followed by the official AIMS Hymn.

3:25 PM – 3:35 PM Welcome Remarks

CAPT. LINO PATERNO W. PADERANGA

Vice President for Academic Affairs (VPAA)

3:35 PM – 5:25 PM

MAIN TESTIMONIAL & AWARDING CEREMONY

Core Proceedings
1

Academic & Licensure Achievements

Presentation of SEA Academic Programs and Licensure Examination Achievements (BSNAME & BSEE).

2
Inspirational Message

DR. ARLENE ABUID PADERANGA

President, Asian Institute of Maritime Studies

3

Testimonial Sharing

Inspirational reflections and journey accounts shared by newly licensed engineering professionals.

4

Intermission Number

Special musical and artistic presentation in honor of the 2026 Board Exam Passers.

5

Recognition & Awarding of Honorees

Conferment of plaques, medals, and official institution citations to NALE, REELE, and RMELE Passers.

6

Message of Program Chairs

Congratulatory remarks from the Program Chairs of BSNAME and BSEE.

5:25 PM – 5:30 PM Closing Remarks

ENGR. JOANNAROSE M. CONGZON

Dean, School of Engineering & Architecture (SEA)

5:30 PM Onwards Ending Sessions

Photo Opportunities, Media Interviews, Fellowship & Dinner

Commemorative photo sessions with dignitaries, faculty, honorees, and families, followed by the celebratory dinner reception.
